scope: Governance USER review bundle context-only packet repair and PR2 review-churn closure
purpose: Prevent PR #311 review from acting as the first adversarial parser by proving all twenty-one Connector findings through source-copy identity, support-authority, support-state, support-reviewability, Markdown semantics, inventory currentness, firewall-matrix routing, write-set receipts, classifier precision, and executable-fixture families before another review request.
reference_effectiveness_note: The first repair reference set covered the five original literal examples but was ineffective against sibling repository text suffixes, benign authority-verb targets, packet-level authority placement, keywordless non-Stage-1 state, and dead fixture control flow. The second repair proved those ten comments but did not require per-support-artifact reviewability, model natural supporting-subject variants, distinguish gated actions from analysis/planning/inspection nouns, execute the documented default firewall against the changed matrix, keep the durable write-set receipt synchronized, or require fixture context around common review prose. The third repair proved those sixteen comments but did not exclude indented code and HTML comments from semantic authority scans or validate the branch receipt in detached HEAD checkouts. The fourth repair proved those eighteen comments but still relied on matrix registration for detached receipt discovery, omitted direct allows/allowed authority forms, and did not compare the generated inventory against final receipt content. This matrix now binds the live twenty-one-comment corpus to executable local proof for all ten observed families.
root_cause_receipt_marker: PR #311 USER Review Bundle Review-Churn Root-Cause Receipt

root_cause_receipts.root_cause: PR Readiness Stage 1 and prior same-PR repair passes used literal examples and validator green as family-completion evidence. They did not inventory all Git-normalized repository text suffixes, distinguish authority verbs by exact gated action including allows/allowed forms, scan support-authority claims across every generated packet surface and natural supporting-subject variant, exclude fenced or indented examples and HTML comments from semantic scans, validate support state independently of optional planning prose, require per-support-artifact reviewability, prove that nested direct-authority assertions actually executed, bind the documented no-option firewall command to the one changed matrix, discover every changed branch receipt directly from the diff in detached HEAD, synchronize later firewall files into the branch receipt, compare generated inventory counts against final receipt content, or require fixture/assertion context around the common phrase never checked.
root_cause_receipts.prevention_summary: PR #311 now uses a ten-family Review-Comment Pattern Matrix, exact live comment counts, generated mutation and sibling replay, executable regression cardinality, packet-wide authority scanning, six direct authority verbs, fenced/indented/comment-aware Markdown filtering, state-first and per-role reviewability validation, repository-format text identity, deterministic changed-matrix selection, diff-native durable write-set validation, generated inventory currentness checks, and context-sensitive comment classification before any later review request.
preventive_changes: dev/orin_user_review_bundle.py classifies the repository's .vbs, .pyw, and .svg sources as Git-normalized text while preserving opaque binary exactness.

dev/orin_user_review_bundle.py ties six direct authority verbs, including allows/allowed forms, to exact USER-gated actions, recognizes support and supporting subjects, excludes analysis/planning/inspection nouns, and scans support-authority claims across every generated packet surface.
dev/orin_user_review_bundle.py validates generated state markers before optional branch-planning prose can trigger an early return.
dev/orin_user_review_bundle.py requires exactly one valid Packet Reviewability State on the Stage 1-ready support artifact.
dev/orin_user_review_bundle.py excludes fenced code, indented code, and inline or multiline HTML comments from semantic state and authority scans.

dev/orin_user_review_bundle_false_green_fixture_validation.py executes all 48 direct subject/verb cases and replays text identity, benign guidance, packet-surface, fenced-state, indented-code, HTML-comment, keywordless-state, reviewability, and gated-action siblings.

dev/orin_pr_review_churn_validation.py auto-selects the single changed review matrix, classifies all twenty-one PR #311 comments into ten precise families, requires fixture context instead of matching never checked alone, discovers every changed non-index branch receipt directly from the diff, and compares final receipt line counts across all generated inventory surfaces.
dev/orin_docs_inventory_reform_audit.py was rerun after the final receipt edits so all generated audit tables report the current receipt line count.
Docs/branch_records/feature_governance_pr1_context_only_packet_fix.md records all ten committed branch files and the bounded repeated Connector repair authority.

connector_corpus_replay.comment: Keep valid-UTF-8 binary blobs byte-exact while limiting newline normalization to known repository text formats.
Include copied source-context files such as .vbs, .pyw, and .svg in Git-normalized text formats.
Reject direct authorization wording when a support artifact authorizes PR creation.
Limit authority verbs to USER-gated targets and scan packet-level support authority claims.
Derive readiness from the Stage 1 Outcome field and validate Support Context State before the planning-keyword return.
Ignore state markers inside fenced Markdown and reject a missing semantic state section.
Execute the direct-authority regression assertions because the constructed cases were never checked.
Load the PR 311 matrix in the mandated firewall because the documented Stage 1 command otherwise uses the default matrix.
Exclude analysis nouns from gated-action matches so implementation analysis, release planning, and merge inspection remain benign.
Recognize supporting-artifact authority subjects such as This supporting context permits PR creation.
Require reviewability on the Stage 1 support artifact with exactly one nonblank valid reviewability state.
Record the added firewall work in branch scope because the Intended Write Set must match the actual committed scope.
Require fixture context before the common review phrase never checked can bypass the unknown-comment guardrail.
Validate branch receipts in detached HEAD checkouts instead of silently skipping the Intended Write Set validation.
Exclude non-semantic Markdown from authority scans, including indented code examples and HTML comments.
Discover changed receipts directly in detached HEAD even when a changed branch receipt is not registered in the selected matrix.
Reject direct allows authority wording such as This support artifact allows PR creation.
Regenerate the inventory after final receipt edits and reject stale generated inventory counts.
